verdict.rationale: First-party docs say sync is optional per graph, so graphs can stay local only. Community users confirm local markdown files they keep in git and can open in other tools such as org-agenda. However, a user reports that the newer database format no longer keeps data as markdown files, and other users report formatting rewrites, non-standard backends and data loss. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that notes are stored as plain files readable without the app, explicit documentation of full offline operation, plain-file ownership in the new DB version, and evidence of reliable data integrity.

support.subject: As a power-user, my notes live in local files or a local-first store that I own and can read without the app, and everything keeps working fully offline

citations.quote: Syncing is a choice that is made per graph and thus allows for some graphs to be local only.
